stem.text: Water of depth $9.0\,\text{cm}$ is covered by oil of depth $5.0\,\text{cm}$ in a measuring cylinder.
The density of the water is $1000\,\text{kg m}^{-3}$ and the density of the oil is $800\,\text{kg m}^{-3}$.
What is the total pressure exerted on the base of the measuring cylinder due to the oil and water?
